description.sv: Norgescup i skateboard (street & miniramp) i Kristiansand, på Blå Kors Aktivitetspark (tidigare Vision skatehall). Klasser för både junior och senior, med prispengar i seniorklasserna.
description.en: Norway Cup skateboarding event (street & mini-ramp) in Kristiansand, at Blå Kors Aktivitetspark (formerly Vision skatehall). Junior and senior classes, with prize money in the senior classes.

source.note: Date confirmed (single day, 14 November 2026) via Brettforbundet's official event page. Exact daily start/end times were NOT published yet ('Mer info kommer nærmere konkurransen' — more info closer to the event) — 09:00-18:00 is an unconfirmed placeholder, verify closer to the date. Discipline listed on the page as 'Street & Miniramp' — mapped to ["street", "park"] since your schema's category list doesn't have a distinct 'miniramp' option; check src/lib/schema.ts if a closer match exists. Level set to "pro" since seniors compete for prize money, but juniors also compete — mixed-level event like a couple of the other recent additions.
